## Selected open-source and community work

- **EWAS-Galaxy / `ewastools`** (2020 — present) — community-facing workflow suite for population epigenetics, published in *GigaScience*
- **Galaxy Training Network** — 26 published or reviewed open-access tutorials and learning resources; editorial board
- **ELIXIR / GOBLET Train-the-Trainer** (2024 — 2027) — co-lead across seven European ELIXIR Nodes and EMBL-EBI
- Contributions to **nf-core**, **Bioconda** and the **ELIXIR RDMkit**
